answer.reason: Several verses tell what Reuben himself did: his sin with Bilhah, his plea for Joseph's life, and his pledge to Jacob.

clauses.english: lay with Bilhah his father's concubine
clauses.quote: Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine

clauses.english: kept his brothers from killing Joseph
offered his two sons as a pledge to bring Benjamin back to Jacob
clauses.quote: Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee

doubts: Many marked verses (numberings, tribal allotments, borders, Levite cities, the altar by Jordan, the sealing in Revelation) concern the tribe of Reuben, not the man, and were left out.
NUM 16:1 and DEU 11:6 name Reuben only as an ancestor of Dathan and Abiram, and JOS 15:6 and JOS 18:17 name him only as father of Bohan, so none of them were used.
The mandrakes (GEN 30:14) and the birth (GEN 29:32) were judged too minor or already covered by the summary.
